The '''''Nantex''-class territorial defense starfighter''', also known as the '''Geonosian starfighter''' or more simply as the '''''Nantex''-class starfighter''', was a needle-shaped [[starfighter]] manufactured by [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]] and used by the [[Geonosian|natives]] of [[Geonosis]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> Many saw service during the [[Clone Wars]] to defend the [[Geonosis droid factories|droid factories]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Databank" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Nantex_cockpit.png|thumb|left|250px|Cockpit view of the ''Nantex''-class starfighter]]
Manufactured by the [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]] on [[Geonosis]], the ''Nantex''-class [[starfighter]] was a territorial defense craft<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> capable of flight in [[atmosphere]] as well as in the vacuum of [[Realspace|space]]. The [[cockpit]] was situated on the top of the craft, where its bubble canopy afforded its single [[pilot]] a three-hundred-and-sixty degree field of view. The nimble starfighters had a sleek, needle-nosed design, with a [[laser cannon]] situated between the forward prongs. This emplacement fired [[Color|purple]] lasers and could swivel to fire in a near-360 degree arc.<ref name="XW2">{{FFGXW2|set=Nantex-class Starfighter Expansion Pack}}</ref> The starfighter was designed for [[Geonosian]]'s unique physiology, capable of maneuvers that would rip most ships—and non-Geonosian pilots—apart.<ref name="StalgasinGuard">{{FFGXW2|set=Nantex-class Starfighter Expansion Pack|cardname=Stalgasin Hive Guard}}</ref> The fighter utilized one hundred small [[tractor beam projector]]s to aid in precision aiming, and allowed for grappling with enemy [[Starship|vessels]] at close range. Despite its relatively small engine, these ships were very fast, achieving 746 miles/hour in atmospheric flight.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> They were also painted with green markings reminiscent to those of the [[pygmy porlceetin]], a large, [[poison]]ous creature found on [[Geonosis]].<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />

==History==
[[File:GraviticDeflection-SWZ.png|thumb|right|250px|A ''Nantex''-class starfighter employing gravitic deflectors.]]
The ''Nantex''-class starfighter was the primary defensive craft of the [[Geonosian]]s of Geonosis.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> Many were deployed during the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], where two served as escort craft for [[Count]] [[Dooku]] on [[Flitknot Speeder Bike|his speeder]] as he attempted to reach [[Count Dooku's solar sailer|his solar sailer]].<ref name="Episode II" /> The fighters were used throughout the [[Clone Wars]] to defend the [[planet]]'s [[Geonosis droid factories|droid factories]], and were affiliated with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Databank" /> ''Nantex''-class fighters fought in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="TCW LaPR">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>
